**In one line**: Anthropic's initial public offering has reportedly been pushed to November.

### Key points
- Investment outlet The Motley Fool reported that the IPO for Anthropic, maker of Claude, has slipped to November.
- The piece frames the growth trajectory as more notable than the timing change itself.
- Listing details and terms may stay fluid until an official announcement.

### Why it matters
An Anthropic listing, alongside OpenAI, would mark a landmark public debut for the generative-AI leaders and set a valuation benchmark for the sector. Both the timing and any disclosed financials could shape investor sentiment across AI companies.
